title: Accusative 4: Neuter Things Stay the Same
description: Neuter nouns ending in -о or -е keep the same form in the accusative.
descriptionRussian: Существительные среднего рода на -о или -е не изменяются в винительном падеже.
intro: By now a pattern should be surfacing. The accusative spends most of its time doing nothing at all: one group changed in lesson 2, and everything else you have met has stayed exactly as the dictionary printed it. Neuter nouns join the second list. That is worth noticing rather than simply accepting, because it means the real skill in this book is not memorizing endings. It is recognizing the few places where an ending is owed.
rules: Neuter nouns end in -о (письмо, окно, молоко) or -е (море, поле, упражнение). The dictionary ending is your gender clue.
Neuter inanimate nouns DO NOT change in the accusative. The form is identical to the nominative: письмо → письмо, окно → окно, море → море.
Some neuter nouns are borrowed from other languages and never change for any case: кафе, такси, метро, кино. These stay the same everywhere, not just in the accusative.
examples: Антон читает письмо. (Anton is reading a letter.) письмо → письмо, no change.
Я открываю окно. (I am opening the window.) окно → окно, no change.
Мы любим море. (We love the sea.) море → море, no change.
Лена пьёт молоко. (Lena is drinking milk.) молоко → молоко, no change.
Папа делает упражнение. (Dad is doing the exercise.) упражнение → упражнение, no change.
Мы любим это кафе. (We love this café.) кафе never changes, because it is an indeclinable noun borrowed from French.

tables.title: Neuter Nouns: No Change in the Accusative

items.hint: Письмо ends in -о. What gender does that signal?
items.explanation: An -о ending signals neuter. Neuter inanimate nouns don't change in the accusative, so the form stays письмо.

items.hint: What gender is окно? What does the -о ending tell you?
items.explanation: Окно is neuter (it ends in -о). The rule for neuter inanimate nouns matches the rule for masculine inanimate: no change in the accusative.

items.hint: Молоко is the WHAT of the verb. Identify the gender first.
items.explanation: Молоко ends in -о, so it is neuter. Neuter inanimate nouns stay in their dictionary form when they are the direct object.

items.hint: Море ends in -е. Which gender uses -е as a dictionary ending?
items.explanation: Neuter nouns can end in -о or -е. Море is neuter. Just like -о neuter nouns, -е neuter nouns also stay the same in the accusative.

items.hint: Упражнение ends in -е. Apply the neuter rule.
items.explanation: Упражнение is neuter (-е ending). Even long neuter nouns follow the simple rule: no change in the accusative.

items.hint: Кафе is borrowed from French. Does it ever change?
items.explanation: Кафе is one of the indeclinable nouns. It came from French and keeps the same form for every case. The accusative (and every other case) is just кафе.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Лето is neuter (-о ending) and inanimate. Neuter inanimate nouns don't change in the accusative.

errorCorrection.sentence: Я каждый вечер читаю заданию по математике.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Every evening I read the math assignment.
errorCorrection.explanation: Задание is neuter (the -е ending marks it), so its accusative is identical to the nominative: задание. Neuter nouns never change shape between subject and direct object.

errorCorrection.sentence: Мы очень любим месту у окна в кафе.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: We really love the seat by the window at the cafe.
errorCorrection.explanation: Место is neuter (-о ending), so its accusative is identical to the nominative: место. After любим the neuter noun keeps its dictionary shape.

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша каждое утро пишет слову на доске.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Every morning Masha writes the word on the board.
errorCorrection.explanation: Слово is neuter, so its accusative is identical to the nominative: слово. The verb пишет acts directly on the word, so the accusative (which looks like the nominative) is required.

errorCorrection.sentence: Она хорошо запоминает каждое слова на уроке.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: She remembers every word well in class.
errorCorrection.explanation: Слово is neuter, so the accusative is identical to the nominative: слово. The word каждое ('every') is singular and neuter, so the noun after it must be the singular form слово: каждое слово.

minimalPairs.explanation: Море is neuter inanimate, so the accusative stays море. Моря is the genitive (used in sentences like 'У берега моря') or the nominative plural ('Все моря Земли').
Мясо is neuter (-о ending) and inanimate, so the accusative stays мясо. Мяса is the genitive, used in sentences like 'Я хочу немного мяса' (I want a bit of meat).

reviewVocab.example: Кафе, такси, метро, кино — несклоняемые существительные.
